files.note: byte-identical copy already in the repo

deviations: juce::SynthesiserVoice bookkeeping (playing note, key/sustain/sostenuto flags, sample rate) inlined; juce::AudioBuffer -> float pointers; jmin/jmax -> std::min/max; MathConstants::halfPi -> kHalfPi
note_id kept per voice so the host releases notes by id

flush_decayed_state(): once per block, resonator states under 1e-18 snap to zero and rung-out velvet bursts are reset (WASM has no flush-to-zero; measured 186 % -> 6 % of real time natively without FTZ)
single MIDI channel; note-off by host note id
sostenuto up clears the voice's sostenuto flag before releasing it (JUCE leaves it set, so Felt's damper never falls on a key released under sostenuto)
set_polyphony(): caps the pool new notes may start in (param 17)
juce::SmoothedValue -> LinearRamp (5 ms); ramps snap before the first block
MIDI CC64/66/67 -> params sustain/sostenuto/soft (>= 0.5 down; sustain continuous for half-pedal); the CC64 damper-felt burst fires on the same transitions

idle flush: after the bus is exactly silent and the output under 1e-9 for 1 s, the room, sympathetic strings, widener, damper-noise filters and grit envelope are reset once; the rung-out damper burst is reset each block
the ABI input bus is ignored and cleared
UI snapshot, metering and state persistence omitted

source.note: Ten DSP sources are byte-identical to kkfonie Felt; felt_voice.h / felt_synth.h / felt_piano_device.* are live-mix's JUCE-free voice, synthesiser and processor, device_api.cpp the ABI shim with device_note_on/off.
